name.description: Name of the virtual machine as it will appear in vCenter inventory.

datacenter.description: Name of the vCenter datacenter that contains the target inventory.

cluster.description: Name of the vSphere compute cluster whose root resource pool will own the virtual machine.

host_name.description: Optional ESXi host to pin the virtual machine to. Leave empty to let the cluster place it.

datastore.description: Name of the datastore that will hold the virtual machine's disks.

folder.description: Optional vCenter VM folder path, relative to the datacenter. Leave empty for the datacenter root.

network_name.description: Name of the port group that the primary network adapter attaches to.

disk_size_gb.description: Size of the primary disk in gigabytes.

guest_id.description: VMware guest OS identifier, for example ubuntu64Guest, windows2019srvNext_64Guest or otherGuest64.

firmware.description: Boot firmware for the virtual machine. Must be bios or efi.

wait_for_guest_ip_timeout.description: Minutes to wait for VMware Tools to report a network address. Set to 0 to disable the wait, which is required for a machine with no installed operating system.

annotation.description: Free-form notes recorded on the created object.
